Sam (eng-platform): Quick sync — following up on the inference incident postmortem. I made a lightweight tracker for remediation owners/timelines and recurring-pattern flags: https://internal/redwood/trackers/rollout-safeguards
Priya (oncall): Thanks Sam. Can you call out which items are high priority for Dedicated customers? :eyes:
Sam (eng-platform): High-priority: auto-rollback on model runtime errors (owner: Lina), blast-radius caps for new feature-flag gates (owner: Carlos). Targeting EOW for proposals.
Lina (eng-sre): I can own auto-rollback. Plan: add a runtime-exception detector in the router that triggers rollback when 5 errors/min for a given deployment. Will open RFC + PR. ETA: 2026-04-02.
Carlos (product): For blast-radius caps, thinking a % of traffic + org whitelist + max-concurrent-sessions limit. I'll draft UX for the flag controls. ETA: 2026-04-06.
Priya (oncall): Also propose a recurring incident pattern monitor: weekly scan for deployments with >3 minor incidents in 30d. Who can add the eval?
Lina (eng-sre): I'll wire a Prometheus rule and a small alert in PagerDuty test group. Add it to tracker.
Sam (eng-platform): Additional items: canary auto-failover policy (fallback model variant) and rollout pacing enforcement (min ramp time). Owner: Sam. ETA: 2026-04-09.
Carlos (product): We should include a "preflight" checklist before enabling a flag: smoke tests, perf baseline, and a quality eval set. I'll add to the console UX checklist.
Priya (oncall): How do we verify auto-rollback won't cause oscillation? Need hysteresis and cooldowns.
Lina (eng-sre): Agreed. Implementation: require 3 consecutive windows of errors, then rollback + 10m cooldown. Documented in RFC.
Sam (eng-platform): Action items summary (from tracker):
- Lina: auto-rollback detector + cooldown (ETA 2026-04-02)
- Carlos: blast-radius caps UI + policy (ETA 2026-04-06)
- Sam: canary auto-failover + rollout pacing (ETA 2026-04-09)
- Lina: recurring-pattern alert rule (ETA 2026-04-03)
- Carlos: preflight checklist in console (ETA 2026-04-06)
Please add PR links into the tracker and mark blockers.
OpsBot: deploy-bot: New issue created: #INF-8423 "auto-rollback RFC" assigned to Lina. https://internal/redwood/issues/INF-8423 :robot_face:
Priya (oncall): Let's sync Tuesday 10am for a short checkpoint. Sam, can you send calendar invite? :calendar:
Sam (eng-platform): Invite sent. I'll update the tracker after PRs land and set weekly reminders until all items are closed. Thanks all :thumbsup:
